FIELDS.NAME: Green Horizon Landscaping Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Horizon Landscaping Services specializes in providing comprehensive residential and commercial garden and landscaping solutions. Our core operations include routine lawn care, garden design, planting services, and minor irrigation system installations. We prioritize working with licensed nurseries and reputable suppliers to ensure high-quality materials and plant health. While we may perform incidental tree trimming and removal, these services are not our primary focus, allowing us to manage risks effectively. Additionally, our team is trained in safety protocols, and we maintain proper documentation for any pesticide or herbicide applications, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. With a strong emphasis on client satisfaction and professional integrity, we strive to create beautiful, sustainable outdoor spaces.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On June 12, 2023, a lawnmower malfunction led to damage of nearby flower beds during a routine landscaping service, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The claim is currently open and under review for assessment and resolution.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system for enhanced security.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Our operations do not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We primarily focus on landscaping services with incidental tree trimming and document all pesticide applications in compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not sponsor athletic teams. Our focus remains on providing landscaping and garden services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our compliance team to ensure risk management and liability coverage.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a commitment to ethical business practices and comply with all regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. We maintain compliance with all insurance requirements and have not faced any issues with coverage.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not lease employees to or from other employers. We rely on our in-house team to maintain control and consistency in our service delivery.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry Workers Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees during work-related incidents.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing comprehensive garden and landscaping services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Our focus remains on managing our existing coverage effectively.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging products. Our operations focus solely on providing garden and landscaping services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on our in-house operations to maintain control and minimize risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. We maintain a stable financial status and comply with all legal and financial obligations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond the incidental use of pesticides and herbicides, which are documented and managed in compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus on residential and commercial landscaping, with an emphasis on routine maintenance and safety protocols. We do not engage in high-risk or hazardous activities that could lead to catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize ethical practices and compliance in our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Green Horizon Landscaping Services has no uncorrected fire code violations. We maintain compliance with all applicable fire codes and safety regulations.
